SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF FEB-07-2020 - MOTION TO VACATE JUDGEMENT IS GRANTED AND THE DEFAULT JUDGMENT ENTERED ON DECEMBER 16, 2019 AS TO CROSS DEFENDANT SUNSET SCAVENGER IS SET ASIDE.. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
MOTION TO VACATE JUDGMENT FILED BY CROSS DEFENDANT SUNSET SCAVENGER IS GRANTED. DEFAULT JUDGMENT ENTERED ON DECEMBER 16, 2019 AS TO CROSS DEFENDANT SUNSET SCAVENGER IS SET ASIDE.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT CROSS COMPLAINANT VINCER, PETER RECOVER FROM CROSS DEFENDANT SUNSET REMODELING & DESIGN INC. $2,440.00 PRINCIPAL, $200.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,640.00, COURT FINDS FOR DEFENDANT IN LOSS OF SIGN. DEFENDANT'S ACTIONS IN DISCARDING SIGN WAS JUSTIFIED BECAUSE PLAINTIFF DID NOT REMOVE TRASH AS HE WAS CONTRACTED TO DO. ON THE CROSS CLAIM FOR BREACH OF CONTRACT BY DEFENDANT, COURT FINDS DEFENDANT FAILED TO PROVE PLAINTIFF WAS LIABLE FOR ARTIFICIAL GRASS IN THE AMOUNT OF $2,288. OTHER ITEMS WERE PROVED BY DEFENDANT FOR RECOVERY OF $2,440.00 * SEE ATTACHED STATEMENT * STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
DECLARATION OF ADDRESS. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.) FILED BY DEFENDANT VINCER, PETER
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-11-2019 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SUNSET REMODELING & DESIGN INC. IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT VINCER, PETER NO EVIDENCE THAT DEFENDANT DESTROYED A SIGN HAVING VALUE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
